metadata.description: Small curated layer for exercise-versus-exercise findings where the direction is clear enough to influence catalog rankings. This is intentionally manual and bounded so comparative studies do not get misread by keyword matching.

winner_aliases: elbow extension training performed in the overhead
findings.finding: Overhead-arm cable elbow extension produced substantially greater MRI-measured triceps hypertrophy than neutral-arm cable elbow extension, while strength increased similarly.
findings.notes: Exercise-selection signal is for triceps hypertrophy, not strength.

findings.finding: Preacher and Bayesian cable curls both increased elbow-flexor thickness and strength, with no clear between-condition hypertrophy winner in the abstract.
findings.notes: Keep as direct evidence when matched, but do not rank one curl above the other from this paper alone.

findings.finding: Nordic hamstring exercise and stiff-leg deadlift produced selective hamstring hypertrophy patterns rather than one broad exercise-selection winner.
findings.notes: This needs regional hamstring targeting before it should affect global hamstring rankings.

findings.finding: Nordic hamstring exercise and stiff-leg deadlift showed strength transfer patterns that are not a simple global ranking win for either exercise.
findings.notes: Useful evidence for specificity and transfer, but not a simple winner-loser catalog adjustment.
